pullRequest.title: Draw the 16 element bars with four layers, a Glow and tooltips
pullRequest.body:
Closes #230

Decisions and guesses are in https://github.com/julian-perge/urchin/issues/230#issuecomment-6950129906

- Added `ElementBar` (`element_bar.tscn`): a 13x70 track and the `ybar`, `bar`, `gbar` and `xbar` layers. `show_value` sets the heights from `MenuMath`, and a height under 0 draws no height.
- Added `element_bar_glow.gdshader` for the Glow on `gbar` and `xbar`, instead of ffdec art, since the layer's height changes. It is within 0.08 alpha of ffdec's render of a full bar.
- `convert_menu_math` now also writes the layer transforms, the Glow, and `elementColorArray`. `MenuTheme.ELEMENT_COLORS` loads the colours from `menu_math.json`.
- Added `bar_shade.png` to `extract_window_chrome`, the gradient that shape 2874 draws over all eight bars of a block.
- The rect record gets the 16 bars, each with a track and four layers, and the two shades. `through_sprites` places a shape through several nested sprites.
- `MenuMath.load_math` parses each file once. Removed `MenuTheme.bar_fill_fraction` and `element_display_value`, and the typed bar nodes of `inventory_window.tscn`.
- Piercing tooltip body is `SYSTEM[38]`, `[37]`, `[39]`, `[40]` with the rounded percentages. Defense body is `DEFTIP` by the five thresholds.

`just gut` passes with 919 tests and `just pytest` with 641.

Review decisions: https://github.com/julian-perge/urchin/issues/230#issuecomment-6950923034 and https://github.com/julian-perge/urchin/issues/230#issuecomment-6951360133

- Ruff now checks comment and docstring width with W505 (88 characters).

nodes.body:
### Decisions from the build of #230

- **Glow.** Julian chose a shader over ffdec art. `scenes/ui/element_bar_glow.gdshader` draws the three-pass box blur of a rectangle in closed form, because a layer's height changes at run time and a picture of one height cannot follow it. I measured it against ffdec's render of a full bar: at most 0.08 alpha apart outside the bar, 0.035 on average. I updated the spec line.
